title: Reverse a List
required_features: Parametric algebraic datatypes for finite lists
Exact equality refinements over logical list values
semantic_obligations: For input [x1; ...; xn], output is exactly [xn; ...; x1]
Preserve every occurrence, including duplicate multiplicity
Preserve no input order except the required total reversal
Remain parametric in the element type: elements are neither compared nor changed
Do not depend on List.rev, List.length, List.append, effects, mutable state, randomness, or partial/error behavior

attempts.diagnostic: Synquid started the append goal, then exited while exploring an ill-typed speculative match: Cannot match shape 'a' with shape 'List (A2)' when checking ys :: List List A2.
Synquid started the snoc goal, then exited while exploring an ill-typed speculative match: Cannot match shape 'a' with shape 'List (A2)' when checking xs :: List List A2.

notes: The final contract is full-strength: it uses logical List-valued reverseSpec equality rather than length/set contracts.
